pos.search: Scan barcode or search name / code…
pos.searchHint: ↑↓ to move · Enter to add · Esc to close
pos.noProductsHint: Add products in Products, or import them from a spreadsheet.
pos.soldOutWarning: {{name}} shows no stock. Added anyway — check the stock count later.
pos.emptyHint: Scan a barcode or tap a product to start.
pos.offlineStrip: Offline — sales are saved on this device

held.noneHint: Use Hold to park a bill and serve the next customer.
held.willHoldCurrent: The bill you have open now will be held when you resume another.

discount.title: Discount
discount.pickItem: Tap an item in the bill first, then open Discount.
discount.needsManager: Over {{limit}}% needs a manager PIN. Manager approval comes with staff accounts.

clearConfirm.title: Clear this bill?
clearConfirm.body_one: {{count}} item (LKR {{total}}) will be removed. Nothing is saved.
clearConfirm.body_other: {{count}} items (LKR {{total}}) will be removed. Nothing is saved.

pay.title: Payment
pay.cardHint: Take the payment on the card machine, then press Complete.
pay.qrHint: Check the customer's app shows the payment as successful, then press Complete.
pay.qrOffline: You're offline. Cash and card are fine; for LankaQR, make sure the customer's app shows success.

done.title: Sale completed
done.noPrinter: To print receipts, set up a printer in Settings.

soon.title: Coming soon
soon.body: This part of Lanka POS isn't built yet.

settings.shopHint: Printed at the top of every receipt.
settings.savedLocalOnly: Saved on this device only — couldn't update the shop online. Check the internet and save again.

printer.title: Receipt printer
printer.intro: Prints a sample English, Sinhala and Tamil receipt as an image.
printer.none: No printers found. Check the cable or Bluetooth pairing, then try again.
printer.savedDefault: Receipts will print on this printer
printer.webOnly: Printing works in the desktop and Android apps. In the browser you can see the preview only.

empty.title: No sales yet
empty.body: Your numbers will appear here after the first bill.

auth.needsInternet: You're offline. Connect to the internet to sign in on this device for the first time. After that, the till works offline.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Shop owners and managers sign in once on each device.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: You'll set up your shop next. Cashiers don't need an account — they use a PIN.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.subtitle: We sent a code to {{email}}. Enter it below.
verify.resent: New code sent. It can take a minute to arrive.
verify.linkHint: Got a link instead of a code? Open it, then come back and sign in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a code to set a new password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Enter the code we sent to {{email}}.

shop.title: Your shop
shop.subtitle: Signed in as {{email}}. This device will be a counter of the shop you choose.

err.offline: Can't reach the server. Check the internet connection and try again.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first — check your inbox for the code or link.
err.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
err.weak_password: Use a longer password: at least 8 characters.
err.over_email_send_rate_limit: Too many emails sent. Wait a few minutes and try again.
err.over_request_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
err.otp_expired: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
err.same_password: Choose a password different from your old one.
err.signup_disabled: New accounts are turned off for this system.
err.cashier_device: Cashiers can't set up a device. Ask the shop owner or a manager to sign in here.

pin.setupSubtitle: You'll use it to unlock the till at {{shop}}, even offline.
pin.nameHint: Printed on receipts as the cashier.
pin.mismatch: The PINs didn't match. Start again.

lock.title: Unlock the till
lock.subtitle: Counter {{counter}} · Choose your name and enter your PIN.
lock.tooMany: Too many wrong PINs. Wait {{count}} seconds.
lock.askOwner: Forgot your PIN? Ask the owner to reset it.
lock.forgotBody: Enter the password for {{email}} to choose a new PIN. This needs the internet.

account.title: Account
account.signOutBody: This removes the shop's data from this device. To use it again, an owner or manager has to sign in.
account.unsynced_one: {{count}} change on this device hasn't reached the cloud yet and will be lost.
account.unsynced_other: {{count}} changes on this device haven't reached the cloud yet and will be lost.
